en: The Question on the Characteristic of Perception (Saññā)
“Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of perception?
“Perception, Great King, has the characteristic of perceiving.
“One perceives blue, one perceives yellow, one perceives red, one perceives white, and one perceives crimson.
Thus, Great King, perception has the characteristic of perceiving.
“Just as, great king, a royal treasurer, having entered the treasury, perceives upon seeing the royal possessions— forms that are blue,
yellow, red, white, and madder-colored— so too, great king, perception has the characteristic of perceiving.
The tenth question: on the characteristic of perception.
